_readme: First draft -- edit freely. Value = tooltip text shown when hint mode is on (Settings popup) and this control is hovered for a moment. {placeholder} fields are filled in from Python via str.format() at the call site (see hints.py); a key with no entry here is silently skipped, so it's safe to leave gaps while this is a work in progress.
setup.server_url: Address of the MIDI-GPT HTTP server this dashboard sends generation requests to.
setup.server_popup.url_input: Server URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3456. A bare host:port is assumed to be http://.
setup.model: Which checkpoint to request generations from -- the server must have it loaded or available.
setup.architecture: The selected model's architecture family (yellow / expressive / prism) -- determines which track controls below are actually usable.
setup.setup_tracks: Auto-name every track from its MIDI content, and optionally add a Sforzando+Arachno instrument to any track that doesn't have one yet.
setup.setup_selected_tracks: Same as Setup Tracks, but scoped to just the selected tracks -- the only way to replace an instrument that's already there.
setup.reset: Reset every Global Setting and Track Control back to its default value.
setup.track_options.mode: Whether this run should just rename tracks, or also add/replace instruments.
setup.track_options.detection: Trust auto-detection from each track's MIDI content, or confirm/override every track yourself before anything is applied.
setup.track_options.replace: If a selected track already has an instrument: leave it alone, or replace it with a fresh Sforzando+Arachno instance.
global.context_length: How many bars of surrounding context the model sees while generating -- more gives it more to work with, but costs more tokens.
global.bars_per_step: How many bars are generated per request step, when the full span is broken into multiple steps.
global.tracks_per_step: How many tracks are generated together in each step.
global.shuffle: Randomize the order tracks/bars are processed in, instead of always left to right.
global.manual_seed: Use a seed you pick instead of a fresh random one from the server every time -- lets you reproduce a specific generation.
global.seed: The seed to use when Manual seed is on.
global.temperature: How much randomness to inject into note choices -- higher is more varied/surprising, lower is safer/more predictable.
global.top_p_enabled: Nucleus sampling -- restrict choices to the smallest set of notes whose combined probability reaches the Top-p value.
global.top_p: The cumulative-probability cutoff for nucleus sampling.
global.top_k_enabled: Restrict choices to only the K most likely notes at each step.
global.top_k: How many of the most likely notes to consider at each step.
global.mask_p_enabled: Anti-nucleus masking -- exclude the most likely notes above this cumulative probability, forcing less obvious choices.
global.mask_p: The cumulative-probability cutoff for anti-nucleus masking.
global.mask_k_enabled: Exclude the K most likely notes at each step, forcing less obvious choices.
global.mask_k: How many of the most likely notes to exclude at each step.
global.polyphony_limit_enabled: Cap the maximum number of simultaneous notes the model may generate, project-wide.
global.density_limit_enabled: Cap the maximum number of notes the model may generate per bar, project-wide.
global.validation: How strictly generated output is checked before being accepted -- stricter settings retry more but take longer.
global.max_attempts: How many times to retry a step if validation rejects it, before giving up on it.
global.temp_escalation_enabled: Raise the temperature on each retry, so a step that keeps failing validation gets progressively more varied instead of retrying identically.
global.temp_escalation: How much to multiply temperature by on each retry.
tracks.ignore: Exclude this track entirely -- it won't be generated on or used as context.
tracks.autoregressive: Regenerate this track's entire context window, not just the bars you've selected -- a full rewrite rather than an infill.
tracks.density_limit_enabled: Cap this track's note density independently of the global setting.
tracks.polyphony_limit_enabled: Cap this track's simultaneous-note count independently of the global setting.
tracks.min_duration: Shortest note duration allowed on this track.
tracks.max_duration: Longest note duration allowed on this track.
tracks.pitch_mask_mode: Restrict which pitches this track may use -- off, a scale, or specific pitch classes.
tracks.pitch_mask_root: Root note for the scale-based pitch mask.
tracks.pitch_mask_scale: Which scale to restrict this track's pitches to.
tracks.pitch_mask_classes: Which pitch classes (independent of octave) this track may use.
tracks.pitch_shape_mode: Softly bias this track's pitch register without hard-restricting it the way the pitch mask above does.
tracks.pitch_shape_min: Lowest pitch of the uniform register.
tracks.pitch_shape_max: Highest pitch of the uniform register.
tracks.pitch_shape_mean: Center pitch of the normal-distribution register.
tracks.pitch_shape_std: How tightly pitches cluster around the center -- lower is tighter.
tracks.remix_enabled: Regenerate this track's existing bars as a variation, instead of leaving them untouched.
tracks.remix_amount: How much to vary the track from its original when Remix is on -- higher changes more.
tracks.remix_mode: Whether Remix varies pitch only, or both pitch and rhythm.
generation.variations: How many candidate variations to generate at once -- pick your favorite afterward. More than one disables live streaming.
generation.generate: Start generating for the current selection. While a generation is running, this button cancels it instead.
generation.batch_candidate: Candidate {index} -- click to write it to REAPER.
settings.hints_toggle: Show/hide these hover hints everywhere in the dashboard.
settings.theme: Pick a color theme for the dashboard.
